min.description: optional minimum value of the clipped range; if ``None`` (default) then result will not be clipped to any minimum value. If specified, it should be broadcast-compatible with ``arr`` and ``max``.

max.description: optional maximum value of the clipped range; if ``None`` (default) then result will not be clipped to any maximum value. If specified, it should be broadcast-compatible with ``arr`` and ``min``.

a.description: deprecated alias of the ``arr`` argument. Will result in a :class:`DeprecationWarning` if used.

a_min.description: deprecated alias of the ``min`` argument. Will result in a :class:`DeprecationWarning` if used.

a_max.description: deprecated alias of the ``max`` argument. Will result in a :class:`DeprecationWarning` if used.

output.description: An array containing values from ``arr``, with values smaller than ``min`` set to ``min``, and values larger than ``max`` set to ``max``. Wherever ``min`` is larger than ``max``, the value of ``max`` is returned.
